title: Are You Addicted to the 'One More Game' Lie?
description: Find out your gaming self-control level when it's past your bedtime!

questions.text: It's 1 AM. Your friend says, 'Last game?'

choices.label: 'Yes, literally the last one. I'm sleeping.'
'Only if we win. No ending on a loss.'
'Sure, but let me check the daily shop first.'
(No response, just hits 'Ready' automatically)

questions.text: You just suffered a crushing defeat. Now what?

choices.label: Close the game. Sleep it off.
Queue up instantly. Revenge time!
Get distracted by a random side quest.
Stare blankly, let the next match load anyway.

questions.text: What usually keeps you playing past your bedtime?

choices.label: Nothing. I respect my sleep schedule.
My ego. I can't let my rank drop.
'Ooh, what's over there on the map?'
I lost track of time 5 hours ago.

questions.text: How do your eyes feel right now?

choices.label: Perfectly fine. Well-rested.
Burning with pure rage.
Strained from reading tiny lore text.
Dry, red, and soul-dead.

questions.text: What's your alarm clock going to do tomorrow?

choices.label: Wake me gently after 8 hours of sleep.
Get snoozed 10 times. I slept at 3 AM.
Interrupt my dream about gaming.
Bold of you to assume I'll sleep tonight.
